	<ResortReportHeadline>4cms of fresh and still snowing!</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>It started snowing again last night and we've accumulated 4cms on the stakes so far with more pulses showing on the radar this morning.</p><p>After an overnight low of -3.3, the current temp is -1.9 and we're headed for a top of -1 degrees. I reckon the weather station has frozen up, but right now it feels like a moderate to strong northwesterly. It's still snowing lightly as I type and there's a light fog in the Village.</p><p>The texture on the groomers feels great underfoot and they'll be offering plenty of fun turns from the outset. There may have been enough new snow off piste for some shallow smooth turns in certain areas. Hunt around some of the more sheltered terrain and see what you can find.</p><p>If you're up for it, night skiing is scheduled this evening down at the Big D from 5pm to 8pm under the lights!</p><p>Rug up for the windchill and have a great day out there.</p><p>Cheers, Burner.</p><p><br></p></ResortReport>

13 cm in 24 hours, however that all fell during the day yesterday.  The sight warming late in the day, followed by cooling in the last few hours has left a very thin crust on the surface.  It will probably be skiing and riding ok in some areas but may be challenging in others.  Take care out there.  </Backcountry>
